reason: Retain the measured 472 code-bearing lines of the cross-platform staging transaction within a 490-line ceiling. The shell selects, audits and stages final package outputs; Linux ABI parsing and floor decisions live in linux_release.abi_audit, while the installed helper probe and pacman candidate checks live in their own modules. Keeping one staging entry point preserves final artifact identity and signature admission without duplicating package-format parsing. The pinned contracts cover ABI refusals, package probing, native family selection and release-channel invariants.
